none.description: No rules anywhere: the base rate of drift

prompt.description: The rules alone in the system prompt: the strong control

ttsr.description: Time travel only: the agent learns a rule when it breaks it

prompt+ttsr.description: Rules in the prompt and enforced

agents-md.description: The same rules as bullets in a realistic AGENTS.md (eval/prompts/agents-md.md)

prompt+ttsr:keep.description: As prompt+ttsr, but the violating response stays in context (Pi only differs)

prompt+ttsr:confirm.description: As prompt+ttsr, with the judge confirming each regex match

ttsr:strict-lease.description: ttsr, and an explicit --force-with-lease value is blocked by regex (eval/variants/strict-lease)

ttsr:judge-lease.description: ttsr, and the judge blocks a lease pinned to the remote's current commit (eval/variants/judge-lease)
